prompt_en: Photograph an explicitly adult 29-year-old woman in a rooftop printmaking studio above a city market. A paper lantern rises on a taut pulley cord beside a print drying rack, its tassel making a short upward blur above the hanging sheets. She stands beside the waist-high print table, pausing with a palm-sized porcelain oval and a thin dark leather map pouch. Use the supplied portrait's visible facial proportions and short dark bob with wispy fringe as the face-and-hair appearance reference. Her eyes and natural upper-and-lower lip contours retain their reference proportions. Her head stays nearly frontal while both irises turn toward the lantern at her anatomical left, on screen right. Both lips are gently drawn forward into a small compact rounded opening: the upper and lower lips of the same declared face project forward in a rounded contour, and the mouth corners of that same face gather toward the center. Her cheek surfaces have even soft light transitions and visible fine natural skin texture; skin color transitions remain locally even, and fine skin texture remains visible without facial-geometry alteration. Her left hand steadies the pouch against the waist-high print table; her left thumb presses its rim inward into a rounded bend and broad soft folds. Her right palm supports the porcelain oval at chest height, with curled fingers beneath it. The oval has a continuous polished glaze and an even reflected highlight. A muted teal wrap blouse drapes softly across her collarbone. Compose a vertical medium close environmental photograph at eye level, keeping her face, mouth, eyes and both held materials clear at native detail; place the pouch and oval near the same depth plane as her face. Bright midday light passes through a translucent ceiling, with faint rooftop geometry and market awnings beyond the rail. The moment feels quietly attentive, intimate in viewing distance, and tactile, with the moving paper form answering the soft fold below.
